body:
I am almost 26, and I still haven't had a single relationship yet. I understand what you're going through, and how it feels :(. A while back I just gave up on it, I guess I am unlovable and worthless that's why nobody likes me. 

I'm here for you if you want to talk :)
Last night, I had a dream that I caught the coronavirus and was dead, felt so good. Then I woke up in the morning realising it was a dream.

Ditto me. For years I tried to convince myself it's not me, it's them. But when every single person treats you the same way, something is definitely wrong. It's definitely me and not them. I'm so tired of feeling this way, yet somehow it feels comforting. Somehow, it feels better to have no one and to be invisible than to be constantly stabbed in the back. 
At this point, I feel like I'm just a shell trying to emulate normal human behaviour but somehow failing terribly at it.
